## 1. Executive Objective
This plan aims to equip the Senior Novel Battery Thermal Specialist with essential company foundations, specific engineering knowledge, and practical skills required to design, test, and integrate advanced thermal management solutions for high-performance battery packs within the Electric Mobility business unit.

## 2. Mandatory Foundation & Domain Modules
*   `SEC-101`: Enterprise Cybersecurity, Zero-Trust & Phishing Defense (Self-Paced LMS, Day 2)
*   `CMP-101`: Global Code of Conduct, Anti-Bribery & Corporate Ethics (Self-Paced LMS, Day 2)
*   `DATA-101`: Data Privacy Governance, GDPR/CCPA & IP Protection (Self-Paced LMS, Day 5)
*   `EHS-101`: Workplace Safety, High-Voltage Awareness & Hazard Control (Self-Paced + Lab Signoff, Day 5)
*   `HW-SAFE-201`: High-Voltage Electrical Safety & ISO 26262 Compliance
*   `FW-RTOS-301`: Deterministic Real-Time Operating Systems & Lauterbach Debugging
*   `MISRA-C-101`: Automotive & Industrial MISRA C:2012 Coding Standards

## 3. Phased 30-Day Competency Milestones
*   **Week 1 Target:**
    *   Complete `SEC-101` and `CMP-101` modules.
    *   Receive enterprise assets, development tools, and lab safety access passes.
    *   Conduct 1-on-1 alignment meetings with direct manager and assigned Senior Engineering Mentor.
*   **Week 2 Target:**
    *   Complete `DATA-101` and `EHS-101` modules.
    *   Begin core prerequisite module: `HW-SAFE-201`.
    *   Request and gain access to GitLab Enterprise / CI-CD and SafeRTOS / HIL Testing Suite.
*   **Week 3 Target:**
    *   Complete core prerequisite modules: `FW-RTOS-301` and `MISRA-C-101`.
    *   Begin hands-on lab setup for Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) workbench.
*   **Week 4 Completion Gate:**
    *   Achieve passing scores on all Enterprise Foundations assessments.
    *   Target completion of 1 low-level driver pull request to pass code review gate.
    *   Ensure 0 critical findings on static analysis run for submitted code.

---

## 4. Practical Hands-On Labs & Shadowing
*   Set up software/hardware devkits required for thermal and powertrain engineering.
*   Establish mentor connections with the assigned Senior Engineering Mentor for ongoing guidance.
*   Perform Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) workbench setup and practice CANoe bus telemetry sniffing.
*   Practice flashing and validating bootloaders on bare-metal ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers.
*   Utilize GitLab Enterprise / CI-CD for accessing firmware repositories, build pipelines, and MISRA C static analysis tools.
*   Engage with SafeRTOS / HIL Testing Suite, local RTOS environments, and Lauterbach / J-Link debuggers.

---

## 5. Certification & Sign-off Gate
Completion of this learning plan is achieved upon:
*   Passing score on all Enterprise Foundations assessments (`SEC-101`, `CMP-101`, `DATA-101`, `EHS-101`).
*   Successful completion of core prerequisite modules (`HW-SAFE-201`, `FW-RTOS-301`, `MISRA-C-101`).
*   Demonstrating practical competence by passing a code review gate on 1 low-level driver pull request.
*   Achieving 0 critical findings on a static analysis run for submitted code.
